estimand: descriptive change in the frozen R3 model-versus-composition contribution under a low-coverage licensed external source

primary_endpoint.name: subject_equal_mean_spearman
primary_endpoint.reason: the source is below the primary R4 minimum in 25 of 30 batches and is not admitted to the primary OOD endpoint

secondary_endpoint.name: coverage_stratified_source_local_rank_sensitivity
secondary_endpoint.eligible_batches: batches with at least 5 positive frozen targets
secondary_endpoint.unit_of_inference: patient/timepoint biological unit as labelled in the source; two technical replicate columns are not independent units
secondary_endpoint.target_coverage_rule: report all 30 batches; mark 5-9 and >=10 target batches separately; never promote the >=5 rule to the primary endpoint
secondary_endpoint.feature_scale: source-local within-batch rank percentile only; the rank denominator is all strictly positive source protein-group rows in that source column, not only frozen targets
secondary_endpoint.rank_definition: inherit R3 descending midrank percentile semantics; zeros and blanks are excluded; the >=5 rule changes eligibility only and never changes the rank denominator
secondary_endpoint.protein_group_ambiguity: retain every target-accession/source-coordinate pair in the audit map, but exclude source coordinates mapping to multiple frozen accessions from any quantitative target rank or model sensitivity endpoint unless a later protocol explicitly freezes a unique-group rule
secondary_endpoint.physical_cell_accounting: report raw source-table cells, unique source coordinates and expanded target-accession/source-coordinate pairs as separate quantities
secondary_endpoint.missingness: source blank and explicit zero remain missing/non-rank-eligible; no imputation
secondary_endpoint.technical_replicates: preserve source columns; any aggregation must be declared in the analysis receipt before execution
secondary_endpoint.technical_replicate_qc: report positive/zero/blank discordance and concordance before any batch-level aggregation
secondary_endpoint.selection_order: freeze model, feature table and nested alpha selection before reading the PXD064962 values; source identity, coordinates and abundance values cannot enter feature selection
secondary_endpoint.uncertainty: patient-level bootstrap only; no IID technical-replicate bootstrap
secondary_endpoint.multiplicity: no confirmatory p-value; descriptive confidence intervals only
secondary_endpoint.negative_control: if executed, permute labels within biological-unit strata and rerun every selection step

prohibited_claims: biological cohort independence beyond the deposited unit labels
required_receipts: analysis receipt with eligible batch count and effective biological-unit count
explicit statement that scientific_submission_ready remains false
